subject.title: feat(config): use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should OpenClaw switch config backups from the numbered `.bak.N` ring to timestamped backup names, and if so must existing numbered backups be preserved or converted during migration?
rationale: Config backups may be the user's only recovery copy, and repository policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive rather than an automation-only choice.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require the linked PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamped retention set.

options.title: Keep The Numeric Ring
options.body: Reject the timestamped naming change for now and document the numbered ring as the intended stable recovery behavior.

options.title: Allow Timestamp-Only Cleanup
options.body: Accept a clean timestamp-only scheme even if first-run cleanup prunes existing numbered backups.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamped retention set.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest visible history on the current backup rotation helper and config recovery semantics.
